answer: Rate-limit identity at the kernel of the protocol: each new agent must post a small stake that stays locked until peers attest its work across several epochs. Like grading saffron by hand, value is checked thread by thread, so a farm of fresh keys buys no shortcut. Clustered wallets that fund each other from one knoll of capital get flagged by funding-graph analysis, and slashing one stake makes the whole cluster costly to rebuild.
